messages.text:
The Quincy 9-inch is a desk globe through and through — compact size, antique ocean tones, and a solid walnut base that looks great on a desk, credenza, or bookshelf. It's a nice warm, old-world look rather than the bright school-globe blue.

Is this one for your own desk, or is it a gift for someone?

Good — the Quincy 9-inch is a great fit for that: small enough to not crowd a desk, but still has raised relief detail and a nice walnut base that looks sharp next to books or a lamp. You'll find it under its exact name, Quincy 9-inch Antique Ocean Desk Globe - Walnut Finish Hardwood Base, ready to add to your cart.
Does this globe have the Canadian provinces and US states labelled?

I don't have that level of map detail in what I know about this globe — whether individual provinces and states are labelled isn't something I can confirm from here. The product page itself or (email hidden) can give you a definite answer on that before you order.
